secondary_sdks.context: Historical name — renamed to @adcp/sdk at 5.23.0 (parallel-shipped through 5.25.1). EOL at 5.25.1 as a separate package. Migration to @adcp/sdk@^7 completed in PR #257 (zod 3→4 alongside, since SDK 7.x peer-deps zod^4.1.5). Watcher keeps this entry to catch any unexpected republish (e.g. a security patch backport to the EOL line).

spec_schema_drift_dirs_context: Directories tree-SHA-diffed between the latest stable spec tag and main, so the watcher reports WHICH files moved rather than only that a version shipped. Scoped to what a signals-only agent can be graded on: the signals request/response schemas, the shared core + protocol schemas they $ref, the signals scenario storyboards, and the universal storyboards every agent runs. Deliberately excludes media-buy / creative / brand / governance dirs — churn there is constant and cannot affect us. Reported drift is NOT automatically a problem: core/targeting.json and the universal contract docs change often for media-buy reasons. The watcher surfaces; a human judges.

Drop after the 4.0 release lands or this issue is closed.

Ours (EvgenyAndroid, filed 2026-06-08). RESTRUCTURED by bokelley 2026-08-04T04:30Z as part of the #4616 Decision-3 'attestation-capable' burst: renamed to '3.2: Runtime signal-quality attestations for check_governance', milestoned 3.2.0 (due 2026-08-31), and the ISSUE BODY was edited by bokelley (GraphQL userContentEdits confirms) to declare it a domain consumer of #4529's shared AttestationReference — our formal RFC comment 4680056151 (2026-06-11) stays 'the implementation starting point', with exactly two elements superseded: inline-JWS-only transport (reference-first now, JWS survives as one embedded-proof format) and per-governance-agent audience binding. Domain still owns: claim semantics (signal-quality vocabulary as NAMESPACED claim_type values, not a closed enum file), subject binding, runtime_attestations[] placement on check_governance, evaluator confidence 0-1 output, capability-hint placement. Implementation is GATED on #4529's schema landing (tracked separately). Resurfaces on WG review comments or a schema PR referencing it. Drop if closed not-planned. (History note: #5429 — our P0 grader-regression report — was fixed by our own merged PR #5444 on 2026-06-11 and dropped from this tracker once the badge re-cleared to passing.)

bokelley's 'RFC: portable attestation references for cross-agent claims' — since the 2026-08-04 Decision-3 burst it OWNS the generic attestation primitive (presentation / credential / evaluation layers, reference-first resolution, verifier-of-record trust from the #6031 creative-provenance posture) that OUR #5418 must consume. Milestone 3.2.0 due 2026-08-31; design-deliverable-first per bokelley. Field names and proof formats explicitly deferred to schema review — that review is OUR window to propose the JWS profile (typ adcp-runtime-attestation+jws, kid/JWKS, exp) as an embedded-proof format and to carry the signal-quality claim vocabulary over as namespaced claim_type values. Fires on any comment, label/milestone change, close, or referencing schema PR. Drop when the shared schema merges and our #5418 revision against it ships.

contribution_page.context: Parity check: every OPEN upstream issue/PR authored by `author` on spec_repo must be cited (linked) on this page's implementer-seat section. One-directional — the page may cite extra numbers (references, maintainer work) freely; only missing authored items count as drift. The page lives in the nofluffadvisory repo at src/pages/standards/adcp.astro. Added after #5739/#5748 (a Conformance-labelled contribution with a live implementation PR) silently missed the manual file-then-update-page routine.

external_registries.name: agenticadvertising_org
external_registries.context: AAO official agent registry (https://agenticadvertising.org/registry/). Fires when agents are added, removed, or rename. Identity = agent URL (stable across renames; surfaces show the new name in the diff). Primary value: catch new ecosystem entrants without manual checks. As of 2026-05-04 the registry has 21 entries; we federate with ~6 of them via /agents/registry — when new agents appear we may want to add them to our local directory.
